text: With the dbt layers mapped, the next planning question is process, not SQL: how does a change to a model safely get into main?
Three rules: every change lives on its own feature branch, nothing merges without a pull request and a review, and a CI check has to pass first.
That CI check runs dbt build and dbt test on every pull request, against a dedicated CI schema in Snowflake -- never against the production marts Power BI reads from.
Branch protection makes it literal: main requires a passing check and a review before it will even let someone click merge, so a broken model can't reach these marts by accident.
The workflow is set. Next: planning how the nightly data actually gets from SQL Server into Snowflake in the first place.
